appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
A light yellow slice labeled 'Nuclear (40%)' occupies the top-left quadrant of the pie chart.
A dark red slice labeled 'Hydroelectric (25%)' occupies the bottom-left quadrant.
An orange-red slice labeled 'Renewables (20%)' occupies the bottom-right quadrant.
A light orange slice labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)' occupies the top-right quadrant.
The four slices are separated by thin white lines and meet at the center point of the circle.

printed_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
The top-right slice is labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)'.

public_definitions: The task requires identifying the largest global energy consumption source category from the pie chart.
The largest category is defined by the percentage value shown within its slice.

The routing decision must be made from the provided options: 'Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring', 'Route Hydroelectric to priority source monitoring', or 'Keep Renewables on routine source monitoring'.
